# Codicons attribution

Codicons by Microsoft and contributors: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons

Bundled unmodified from the official `@vscode/codicons` npm package, version 0.0.45.
`SOURCE.json` records the source archive and checksums. `mapping.json` is the upstream
`src/template/mapping.json`; `codicon.ttf` is the upstream `dist/codicon.ttf`.
Icons/content: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (`LICENSE`).
Code: MIT (`LICENSE-CODE`). No glyphs or font outlines were modified.

The complete font and name mapping are embedded in the application. No font
installation, npm, network access, or Qt SVG module is needed at build/run time.
